evaluation: intake intent classifier, final evaluation of releases v1 and v2 side by side (report 02, sections 9 and 10)

protocol.v1: fitted on the train split, selected and calibrated on the dev split, and scored on the generated test split and the final sets before v2 existed, in repeated runs of the same frozen model; the macro-F1 averaging rule was corrected once between those runs, which changed only the mixed and team slices
protocol.v1_repeat: this report scores v1 with the same models, rows, seed and resamples as that run, so its v1 numbers repeat that run's, except on the team set, where two labels were corrected afterwards (below)
protocol.v2: designed after the v1 and keyword-router results were known: on the generated test split the router was ahead of v1, mostly in Portuguese and on out-of-scope rows, and v1 dropped on paraphrase families it had not seen, which is why v2 adds the router's rules as features; it was then selected only by grouped cross-validation on train + dev (folds by paraphrase family) and is scored here with frozen weights
protocol.final_sets: the final sets in eval/holdout/ were not used to design or select either model; they are only scored
protocol.known_results: the results of v1 and of the keyword router on every set, including v1's error lists, were known when v2 was designed, so the v2 comparisons on these sets are a second look at rows whose results were known, not a first one
protocol.next_check: no fresh set exists for v2: the team hand-written set has 61 messages by one team member and will not grow before the deadline
protocol.labels: two team hand-written labels (hand-es-025, hand-pt-009, a relative's balance) were corrected to out_of_scope on 2026-10-03 to match the labeling convention, as logged in eval/holdout/README.md; the inconsistency was flagged when the file was imported, before any model was scored, and this report was regenerated after the change

systems.majority: the most frequent intent of the train split
systems.model_v1: release v1, bilingual, forced choice (top-1 intent)
systems.model_v1_threshold: release v1, bilingual, under the policy threshold (abstains below it)
systems.model_v2: release v2, bilingual, forced choice (top-1 intent)
systems.model_v2_threshold: release v2, bilingual, under the policy threshold (abstains below it)
systems.model_es_only_v1: release v1, trained on Spanish rows only (transfer set)
systems.model_es_only_v1_threshold: release v1, Spanish only, under the policy threshold (transfer set)
systems.model_es_only_v2: release v2, trained on Spanish rows only (transfer set)
systems.model_es_only_v2_threshold: release v2, Spanish only, under the policy threshold (transfer set)

scoring.correct: the prediction is one of acceptable_intents
scoring.macro_f1: F1 against the effective label (prediction if acceptable, else intent), averaged over the gold classes present in the full slice; every bootstrap resample uses the same classes, and a class with no row and no prediction in a resample counts as F1 0
scoring.macro_f1_interpretable: false when a gold class of the slice has fewer than 5 rows: read accuracy there
scoring.selective_macro_f1: macro-F1 over the rows the thresholded model answers, averaged over the gold classes of those rows in the full slice (fixed across resamples)
scoring.abstention: a *_threshold system abstains when the rounded confidence is below 0.55 (handoff.min_intent_confidence); an abstention matches no class, so it is a miss in macro-F1 and accuracy
scoring.recall_by_intent: rows grouped by their intent; share whose prediction is acceptable
scoring.dispute_recall: rows whose intent is one of the two dispute classes; share predicted acceptably
scoring.dispute_detected: the same rows; share predicted as either dispute class
scoring.out_of_scope_false_accept: rows whose intent is out_of_scope; share predicted as a class that is not acceptable for the row (abstentions excluded from the numerator)
scoring.calibration: ECE on the top probability (correct = top intent acceptable), multi-class Brier against the effective label, log-loss of the probability mass on the acceptable intents
scoring.interval: 95% percentile bootstrap over rows; paired across systems within a slice
scoring.variants: sets test, independent, team: keyword router and bilingual models on the rows of each language variant, with the accuracy gap of the variant minus the other rows of the set (resampled separately); added after every other number in this report was known, from the same predictions; fixed in advance: fewer than 20 rows in the variant or in the rest is "sample too small to conclude" and gets no gap

selection.rows: train + dev, grouped cross-validation by paraphrase family (out-of-fold)
train + dev, grouped cross-validation by paraphrase family (out-of-fold)

test.description: generated test split (split == test) of intent_dataset.jsonl
